preconditions.description: The input contains exactly T+1 tokens: the first is T, followed by T integers.
The number of test cases T is between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(n) <= 20000 for n in stdin.strip().split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case integer N is between 1 and 20000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((s == s[::-1] and line == 'wins') or (s != s[::-1] and line == 'loses') for s, line in zip([n for n in stdin.strip().split()[1:]], stdout.strip().splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each input number N (as string s), the corresponding output line is 'wins' if s is a palindrome (s equals its reverse) and 'loses' otherwise.
